lines.text: The root is Vert! Invert, version.
Did you know? Vert is Latin for turn.
Version: a turn, one form of a thing.
Quick quiz! Which means into plus turn?

words.ex: Invert the cake onto a plate once it has cooled.

words.mean: a turn, one form of a thing
words.ex: The new version of the app is much faster.
